verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of exporting the full source code or running or hosting the app outside Figma Make. The docs show in-platform file browsing, code editing, and on-platform publishing with a custom domain, but none of these is code export or off-platform hosting. Community reports say the API returns 400 for .make files and users had to reverse-engineer the binary format with their own scripts to extract the React app; that is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export the full source code and run or host the app outside the platform
